column1: # Sign-in methods whose labels were longer than 40 characters before scripts/check.sh limited
# them: package, then method. Their labels are part of their providers' identity, so they stay
# as they are (AUTHORING.md, "Auth"); check.sh skips the limit only for these. Measured on main
# at 25e4005 by loading every package and listing each label over 40 characters. Never add a
# line: a new method needs a short label.
